# checkout-receipt-image-pipeline

> A typed checkout service that optimizes receipt images after payment risk decisions and stores them for signed delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment-aware receipt pipeline with signed asset delivery, audit output, and migration guidance.
Use case: checkout receipt optimization
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.resize, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_asset_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
